new_value: Asymmetric-link detector landed (diag.10, spec 02a 2a.10.5 family): lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/asymmetric_link.c + include/lichen/asymmetric_link.h — freestanding per-peer TX/RX tracker over a bounded 16-peer table with oldest-first eviction; lichen_asym_link_record_tx/record_rx feed per-peer counts; lichen_asym_link_evaluate(now) flags peers where TX >= 10 and TX:RX ratio > 10:1 over the 5-minute window (diag.10 spec: 'ratio > 10:1 over 5 minutes'), returning the asymmetric peers' IIDs for lichen_diag_report(FLEET_ASYMMETRIC_LINK). Fleet event codes (LICHEN_DIAG_FLEET_ASYMMETRIC_LINK/SLOT_DRIFT) added to diag.h as the shared diag-family vocabulary. Bounded 16-peer capacity with stalest-first eviction (ponytail: O(n) scan, upgrade path a proper LRU). Verification: standalone behavioral harness — 15 TX/0 RX alice flagged, 15:3 bob (5:1) below threshold, 15:15 carol symmetric, pre-window evaluate returns 0, sub-threshold 5-TX peer not flagged — all pass under -Wall -Wextra -Werror. CMake updated to compile asymmetric_link.c. Codereview 1x Kimi K3: PASS, no defects (ratio boundary math, eviction, overflow, no OOB all verified). Wiring (who calls record_tx/record_rx from the L2 RX path) deferred to the integration bead that owns the gateway assembly — the detector itself is the standalone deliverable per the bead text.
